Adaptive greedy that scores candidates by a Clarke-Wright-style savings term, a fill-pressure term penalizing large residual capacity, and a depot-radial far-first term, combined additively with weights that adapt to how full the vehicle is, returning the depot when no candidate yields positive marginal gain.

generation_parents.algorithm: Adaptive greedy that scores candidates by a Clarke-Wright-style savings term, a fill-pressure term penalizing large residual capacity, and a depot-radial far-first term, combined additively with weights that adapt to how full the vehicle is, returning the depot when no candidate yields positive marginal gain.
Frozen_V0: Linear score d_cur - 0.6*d_dep - 1e-6*dem without capacity gate.
